svg.title: What V8 and V9 actually qualify before exporting predictions
svg.desc: Two pipelines compare accepted V8 four-view inference with V9 blend inference. Each gate uses an absolute count, both write a receipt before root bytes, and completed official scoring is separate.
svg.text: Prediction gates are contracts, not leaderboard scores
Exact accepted sources · native qualification on three visible studies · October 9, 2026 UTC
V8 · four-view path
V9 · BK-A + mirror blend
Native session 356846883 · root: four_view
Native session 356849298 · root: blend
Keep original 320 pair; add optional 384 views
A failed optional view is omitted from its study average
Mirror stage + independent BK-A stage
Restore chain snapshot; define fresh root helpers
Limit = 0.005 × cohort size
Count neutral 320 pairs + failed builds
Build overlap can count twice; visible rank hash also applies
Limit = max(0.005 × cohort size, 1)
Union BK-A fill rows with mirror neutral rows
Add mirror builds conservatively; visible mirror hash applies
Above limit → recompute every study
Healthy two-view reference, or no root if still rejected
Select healthy blend / BK-A / mirror
Mirror failure → whole-cohort reference or no mirror arm
N = 3: limit 0.015 · counted degradation 0
Three studies × four views succeeded in native receipts
N = 3: limit 1 · counted degradation 0
BK-A, mirror and blend gates succeeded natively
Gate root → persist receipt → export exclusive root bytes → verify SHA256
Then obtain a separate accepted submission and exact COMPLETE score row. No new score is proven here.
Audit limit: saved downloads omit raw NPZ arrays; per-study masks cannot be independently reconstructed.
